title: Diagnosis of Lung Lesions by Endobronchial Ultrasound With an Alternative Guide Sheath
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to examine the usefulness of a balloon covered sheath as a guide sheath in endobronchial ultrasound guided transbronchial biopsy and bronchial brushing cytology for diagnosis of peripheral lung lesions
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with peripheral pulmonary lesions who are going to receive bronchoscopy

Exclusion Criteria:

* endobronchial abnormalities
* associated lung parenchyma changes, ex. lung collapse or atelectasis
